title: Creepy theater and elevator
content: I've made this comment a few times recently but decided to make a dedicated post with some AI images. I was in a giant lobby of this creepy old movie theater and was told by the ticket person not to go into the theater or I'd be taken or affected in some way. I walked up these tall red velvet stairs to the entrance of the theater, but decided not to go in. I came back down near the ticket person and then look up the stairs to see this giant color changing transparent liquid come out of the theater and form into a head. It said "SMOKE. SMOKE. SMOKE." I freaked out and went into a nearby elevator with 3 other people inside. The elevator then started quickly rising. I remember it maxing out at floor 136. Then it quickly starts descending. I realize it goes below the main level and keeps falling. It stops and the doors open up to a purple cave like hallway with eyes on every surface. The walls, the floor, the ceiling, and pillars all had eyes. It was deathly quiet and felt like we were supposed to go out but none of us wanted to leave the safety of the elevator. I then was awoken to a power outage in my house. That was easily one of the freakiest dreams I've had in a while. The AI images aren't exactly right. The elevator basement with rhe eyes is pretty close, but it was more cave-like. Also the theater had a small circular concession area and the stairs were much taller, without any railings, leading up to the theater door at the top. Has anyone else had a dream like this?
